defects: The input connection includes a small rectangular detour just above/near J3 and the regulator input, with closely packed supply-entry annotations.
The J3 reference/value placement competes with that wire and nearby power decorations.
Visually this is much improved over versions with J3 stranded, but it does not yet look clean.

Connector J1, power unit U1C, active unit U1A and parked unit U1B are spread as separate islands; the power unit sits between connector and signal stage rather than reading as a cohesive supply block.
VPLUS/VMINUS labels project sideways and the 100 nF capacitors are geometrically asymmetric.
The unused stage is below the active stage without a clear local association.
C2 (CONT 10 nF) has its GND symbol above the capacitor, creating upside-down visual flow.
The C2 wire extends parallel to VCC pin 8 in a crowded area.
The output J2 is substantially below/right of the oscillator and is reached by an unnecessarily tall down-and-around route.
U1C appears substantially below the signal blocks, with VMINUS drawn by an upward-pointing arrow on the lower bypass path and an awkward rail arrangement relative to C2.
The visually disconnected power/decoupler section reduces the drawing's cohesion.
C2's REF symbol sits above the 10 nF control-voltage capacitor; its lead shares a visually crowded corridor with the VCC pin 8 connection.
The J1/R1 area has two nearby VCC glyphs plus a power flag.
The REF power flag appears on an unnecessary-looking dangling branch beneath C1.
These are not necessarily electrical errors, but they complicate the drawing.
This resembles B04, with REF rather than GND.

The timing network is readable and connectors are grouped, but C2's REF symbol is above the capacitor, the control-voltage lead runs in the crowded pin-5/pin-8 channel, and the output connector sits at the end of a long vertical drop.
The connection from connector J1 pin 1 heads upward and around before reaching R1, despite a largely straight signal line being possible.
The supply power unit/decouplers form a detached visual cluster below the amplifier stages, including a reversed-looking VMINUS marker.
There is extra horizontal whitespace within an otherwise modest circuit.
U1B is located high above the actual amplifier, apparently detached from the package's active signal context.
U1C/C1/C2 are far left of the signal block.
The page is geometrically valid but visually fragmented, and power arrows are not conventionally arranged.

The diagram places 'Negative supply' on the left and 'Reference' on the right, while the conventional current-direction reading of this indicator is from the higher-potential reference, through the resistor/LED, toward the negative supply.
It therefore reads right-to-left, and the odd top and lower U-shaped wires make this simple indicator unnecessarily hard to scan.
A relatively long C4 loop spans the signal section; some of that may be necessary to communicate the active filter, but the power block U1C/C1/C2 sits well to the right, isolated from U1A/U1B.
The unused U1B and active U1A have an awkwardly tight vertical pairing beneath the feedback.
Supply glyphs around U1C are not optimally oriented.
VREF is carried across a long horizontal bus that also interacts visually with the U1C power-symbol region; supply arrows are inconsistently oriented.
The op-amp signal/unused units are separated from the divider and power panel without a clear block relationship.
The drawing is valid-looking but requires more effort to understand than the circuit merits.
